title: DB-031: multi-lot condo records-view channel + display (T045-wave riders; guard-coherence design answered)
objective: Give the architect surface an honest RECORDS VIEW of a multi-lot condo: a real per-BBL production channel carrying the condo resolution report (the recorded billing lot, every recorded base lot, and each base lot's recorded zoning districts, all with provenance) plus the display section per D-073-R006 - records only, no aggregation, no computed value, the professional-review fail-safe preserved for every non-single outcome. ANSWER the T045 G3-A2 guard-coherence design question in the plan BEFORE implementing: when a condo resolves to a SINGLE base lot the substitution proceeds (the allow path) while the identity notice explains the substitution - versus the multi-lot/unresolved outcomes where the withhold guard governs; the plan documents which guard owns each outcome so the two can never disagree, and the display implements exactly that ruling. Carry the remaining T045-wave riders in-scope: route propagation of condo_resolution_report, the cross-boundary fail-safe token pin, the unit-BBL resolution increment, the substrate-record of the substitution, and the records-section heading semantics.
business_reason: The 230th acceptance wired condo billing-BBL resolution fail-closed but deliberately split the multi-lot records VIEW out (DB-031): a professional reviewing a multi-lot condo today sees only the fail-safe stop with no view of what the city actually records - the honest records view is the missing half

DESIGN ANSWER REQUIRED FIRST (binding; the T045 G3-A2 load-bearing question): BEFORE any implementation checkpoint, your plan documents the guard-coherence ruling - (a) resolved-single outcome: substitution proceeds (the allow path the accepted resolver already provides) AND the identity notice EXPLAINS the substitution as a record ('analysis runs on the land parcel the city records for this condo'); (b) multi-lot outcome: the withhold guard governs (professional-review fail-safe stays the visible surface) AND the NEW records view shows what the city records - the recorded base lots and their recorded zoning - clearly labeled records, never inputs to a computation; (c) unresolved/error: withhold, no records view, honest absence. State the single source of truth that keeps the notice, the fail-safe allow-list guard (condoWithholdsAllowances, PropertyOverview.tsx:116-123 + ReportView.tsx:38), and the new records section from EVER disagreeing (one derived state, not three parallel conditionals) - the cross-boundary token pin rider means the SAME literal outcome token crosses the api/web boundary and is pinned by tests on BOTH sides.

acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (design first): the guard-coherence ruling is documented in the plan/report BEFORE implementation checkpoints - one derived state, the outcome token pinned identically on both sides of the boundary; reviewers can point to the single source of truth.

AS-2 (multi-lot primary): for a recorded multi-lot condo fixture, the route returns the billing lot + every recorded base lot with recorded zoning + provenance; the screen renders the records section labeled as city records UNDER the unchanged professional-review fail-safe; no allowance value appears anywhere in the section.

AS-3 (single): a single-base-lot condo (the DB-029c real fixture shape, key-absence semantics) proceeds on the allow path; the identity notice explains the substitution as a record; the response's substrate-record names entered vs analyzed BBL.
AS-4 (unit BBL): a unit-BBL input resolves through the accepted path to its billing/base outcome (single-> proceeds, multi->withhold+records), tested at the route.

AS-5 (absence/error honesty): not-a-condo -> typed outcome, no records section, existing behavior untouched; resolver error -> typed error, withhold, no fabricated records; SODA key-absence tolerated per the accepted resolver semantics.

AS-6 (records discipline): heading + wording are RECORD class (HJ-A3 heading semantics: never analysis/result words); the D-073-R006 grep gate - no allowance-class vocabulary in the records section; the condoWithholdsAllowances guard byte-unchanged in semantics.

AS-7 (compat): the six PropertyOverview consumers + three AnalysisIdentityNotice consumers unbroken (props/exports byte-compatible); every prior M5-T045 journey assertion green except those the documented ruling updates WITH tests.
AS-8 (proof): ruff clean; documented api suites green offline from services/api; modularity exit 0 (new route + client below warn tier); web proves in CI on the pushed head (orchestrator captures).
